answer: Bonded progressive trust stops sybil farming: each agent posts a refundable work bond and starts with a tiny task cap. Every independently verified job raises the cap one notch, so reputation climbs in a slow trust spiral that cannot be bought or rushed, while fraud slashes the bond and resets the cap. A sybil attacker must fund a bond and complete real checkable work for every fake identity, like cutting each marble block and polishing each opal by hand, so attack cost grows linearly while honest agents keep their bonds.
